# Find Missing Elements

| Field | Value |

| Platform | LeetCode |

| Submitted | 2026-08-04T14:56:55.000Z |


## Solution

```python
class Solution:
    def findMissingElements(self, nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
        nums.sort()
        ans = []
        for i in range(len(nums) - 1):
            for x in range(nums[i] + 1, nums[i + 1]):
                ans.append(x)
        return ans
```
